steps.say: Ha. Hit. Clean hit, too. Seventy years, and not one of the boys ever landed one on me.
The Synod sealed us in to keep the powder from the world. Powder is a fire men made, they said. Vanity.
Funny thing. The Drip never came down here. Not once. The boys went black, the mule went daft, but none of us went to wax.
It's the saltpetre. Has to be. It's in the air, in the walls, in us. The thing that eats the Wick can't stomach it.
Take the gun. Don't waste the last charge on me; I'm spent.
And if you find where the saltpetre comes from... Brinewell, the old salt-diggers called it... go and see why it's so bitter.
He salutes, very correctly, and his hand does not come down.
